disk_temptable_create_cost.description: Cost of creating an internal temporary table in a disk-resident storage engine. Increasing the value makes plans using disk temporary tables more expensive.

disk_temptable_row_cost.description: Cost of inserting, retrieving, or storing a row in an internal disk-resident temporary table.

io_block_read_cost.description: Cost of reading an index or data block from disk. Increasing the value makes plans that read many disk blocks more expensive.

key_compare_cost.description: Cost of comparing two keys during query execution.

memory_block_read_cost.description: Cost of reading an index or data block from an in-memory database buffer.

memory_temptable_row_cost.description: Cost of retrieving or storing a row in an internal temporary table held in memory.

row_evaluate_cost.description: Cost of evaluating record conditions. Increasing the value makes plans that examine many rows more expensive.
